guard: the repair command a delegation refusal prints authors the narrow spawner the sentence describes, not the whole-plane one an omitted flag defaults to
why: The same composition as the view refusal, one door over, and with a longer reach. This refusal
printed `cotal actor grant <a> --owner <o> --scope spawn` and stopped, so an operator repairing a
broken delegation chain authored a spawner that reads and posts on every channel in the space.
A spawner's own ACL is the CEILING every agent under it is attenuated against, so that ceiling then
governed everything spawned under it from that point on. The sentence promised a spawn capability
and delivered the whole plane, indefinitely.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite imports the ledger by relative source path (../src/index.js), so the
mutated file is the file that runs and there is no build in the command.

mutations.name: S1 the missing-spawner repair command names --scope and stops
mutations.find: ? `spawner "${parentKey}"${deep ? ` (an ancestor of "${leaf}")` : ""} has no grant in this space - delegation flows from a granted spawner chain; grant it first, spelling out EVERY field (\`cotal actor grant ${pActor} --owner ${pOwner} --scope spawn --allow-subscribe '<what its agents may read>' --allow-publish '<what they may post>'\`): an omitted flag is the WIDE default, \`>\` read and \`>\` post, and a spawner's reach is the ceiling for everything spawned under it`
mutations.replace: ? `spawner "${parentKey}"${deep ? ` (an ancestor of "${leaf}")` : ""} has no grant in this space - delegation flows from a granted spawner chain; grant it first (\`cotal actor grant ${pActor} --owner ${pOwner} --scope spawn\`)`
mutations.expectRed: the missing-spawner repair command names read AND post, not --scope alone
mutations.cell: the missing-spawner repair command names read AND post, not --scope alone
mutations.note: This is the shipped state of the text. Every other cell stays green: the row is still refused, the refusal still names the missing spawner and still carries the `has no grant in this space` needle the neighbouring cell matches on.
